# Deadwood Reblooms v1.3.2 / 枯木逢春 v1.3.2

面向 **DoL 0.5.12.13**，需要秋枫白桦框架 **5.2.2 或更新版本**及主包声明的其他依赖，建议更新至框架 **5.2.3**。发布附件为加密 `.modpack`；动态音乐音频包仍为可选安装。

## 修复：银行职员

- 银行职员由 Ellis／埃利斯改名为 **Adrian／阿德里安**，人物标识、日程、立绘、社交头像、剧情与指南同步改名，避免与其他模组的 Ellis 共用人物数据。
- 对话不再调用仅接受原版人物的 `npcincr`；熟悉度增减限制在 **0–50**，两种回复共用一次性结算，重复点击不会重复增加或扣除数值。
- **本次不迁移旧 Ellis 的人物数据及银行职员业务进度。**阿德里安的熟悉度、接待记录与晋升进度重新开始，原有银行账户、余额与贷款不受改名影响。

## 新增与完善

- 自有住宅可购买海报、壁纸与定制图案。修复关闭社交头像模块后海报图标丢失的问题。
- 海报及社交头像图片统一使用连字符命名，保持现有像素图稿。新增罗宾店铺、账本、营业许可及画本等链接图标，补齐饮品店和住宅的地点底图、雪景与灯光层。
- 果树浇水可维持七天，肥效维持三十天；成熟果树同样需要水分，灌溉与雇工照料覆盖幼树及成树，详情显示剩余水分与肥效。季节继续只影响成熟果实产量。
- 罗宾饮品店保留应聘者、值班人员与熟客记录，新增孤儿院同伴的聘用、培训、成长和工资互动。家教学生与家长、健身房教练的训练记录也会保留并影响后续对白。
- 新增「嗜虐」特质及「三位一体」祈祷室事件，完善神圣转化的数值加成与相关提示。具体条件见游戏内原版增强指南。
- 整理 DoLP／DoLX 中部分属性与罗宾业务结算的接入；这不表示对 DoLX 全部转化提供兼容。

## 校验与安装

源码、格式、类型检查和构建打包通过；定向校验覆盖阿德里安注册、日程、头像引用、对话数值边界及重复点击。资源校验确认改名后的四张头像与原图字节一致。本次未进行完整游戏流程及双模组联测。

先更新框架，再安装主包；使用动态音乐时安装对应音频包。旧版果园与其他功能的介绍见 [v1.3.0](https://github.com/MaplebirchLeaf/Deadwood-Reblooms/releases/tag/v1.3.0) 与 [v1.3.1](https://github.com/MaplebirchLeaf/Deadwood-Reblooms/releases/tag/v1.3.1) 更新说明。

---

This release targets **DoL 0.5.12.13** and requires **Maplebirch Framework 5.2.2 or newer**, plus the main package's other declared dependencies. Updating to **5.2.3** is recommended. Release assets are encrypted `.modpack` files; the dynamic music audio pack remains optional.

## Fixed: bank clerk

- The bank clerk has been renamed from Ellis to **Adrian**, including the NPC identifier, schedule, portrait, social avatar, scenes and guide. This avoids sharing NPC data with another mod's Ellis.
- Conversation responses no longer call the vanilla-only `npcincr` macro. Familiarity changes are clamped to **0–50**, and both responses share a guard against repeated settlement.
- **Legacy Ellis NPC data and clerk-specific business progress are not migrated.** Adrian's familiarity, visits and career start afresh. Existing bank accounts, balances and loans are unaffected by the rename.

## Added and refined

- Owned homes support posters, wallpapers and custom designs. Poster icons remain available when the social avatar module is disabled.
- Poster and social avatar assets use hyphenated filenames while retaining their existing pixels. New shop, ledger, business-permit and sketchbook link icons accompany base, snow and light layers for Robin's shop and owned properties.
- Orchard watering lasts seven days and fertiliser lasts thirty. Mature trees also need water, irrigation and worker care cover both young and mature trees, and details show remaining water and fertiliser duration. Seasons still affect only mature fruit yields.
- Robin's shop remembers applicants, staff on duty and regular customers, with orphanage-companion hiring, training, experience and wage scenes. Tutoring students and parents and the gym coach's training records also persist and affect later conversations.
- Add the Sadomasochism trait and Trinity prayer-room event, with divine transformation bonuses and guide entries. See the in-game Vanilla Plus guide for conditions.
- Refine selected stat and Robin business-settlement integrations for DoLP and DoLX. This does not provide compatibility for every DoLX transformation.

## Validation and installation

Source, formatting and type checks and build packaging passed. Targeted checks cover Adrian registration, schedules, avatar references, conversation limits and repeated clicks. The four renamed avatars are byte-identical to the originals. Full gameplay and a two-mod playthrough were not tested.

Update the framework before the main mod and install the matching audio pack if needed. See the [v1.3.0](https://github.com/MaplebirchLeaf/Deadwood-Reblooms/releases/tag/v1.3.0) and [v1.3.1](https://github.com/MaplebirchLeaf/Deadwood-Reblooms/releases/tag/v1.3.1) notes for earlier orchard and other features.
